## Type of Change

The PR title must use a conventional commit prefix, because the squash-merge
commit feeds [semantic-release](https://python-semantic-release.readthedocs.io/):

- `feat:` — New feature (minor bump)
- `fix:` — Bug fix (patch bump)
- `perf:` / `refactor:` — Improvement (patch bump)
- `build:` / `chore:` / `ci:` / `docs:` / `style:` / `test:` — No release
- `feat!: ...` or a `BREAKING CHANGE:` footer — Breaking change (major bump)

<!-- Keep the checkbox that matches the PR title. -->

- [ ] `feat` — New feature
- [ ] `fix` — Bug fix
- [ ] `perf` — Performance improvement
- [ ] `refactor` — Code refactoring
- [ ] `docs` — Documentation
- [ ] `test` — Tests
- [ ] `chore` / `ci` / `build` — Maintenance
